en.description:
## ASUS Prime B760M-K

A reliable mATX motherboard for Intel 12th, 13th and 14th generation processors, with DDR5 support.

- LGA1700 socket
- DDR5 memory support, up to 192 GB
- PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, M.2 NVMe support
